topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes impact power allocation by altering array factors and interference patterns. Quasi-TE1 mode's higher scan loss reduces beam overlap, decreasing interference, but increases power requirements. Dynamic power allocation and beamforming techniques can mitigate these effects, optimizing system performance and capacity.
reference_context: Multi-beam satellite systems require flexible power allocation due to varying scan losses and interference patterns, affecting system capacity and performance.
